blockers.description: Official documentation bodies and per-page hashes are external, so provider-required subjects remain blocked.
The exact generated documentation build and API closure are not reproduced.

limitations: This exact metadata inventory does not establish dependency compatibility, native CLI behavior, backend equivalence, model validity, or scientific acceptance.

External raw identity is the SHA-256 of canonical sorted git ls-tree -r receipt lines '<mode> <object_type> <object_id>\t<path>\n' for every inventory entry; the local inventory JSON is metadata evidence only and contains no official document body bytes.
The inventory identity binds the exact pre-migration catalog bytes as migration metadata; it does not identify any upstream document body.

document-bodies-not-retained.description: Only exact Git path and object metadata are retained; official documentation body bytes remain external.

generated-build-not-replayed.description: Generated API/reference pages and the exact documentation build have not been replayed.

runtime-artifacts-excluded.description: Tutorial datasets, NumPy/HDF5 payloads, checkpoints, models, pickles, and other executable or serialized artifacts are metadata-only and are never loaded.
